name: DailyDrawings
short: Daily paper drawing challenges with a fifteen-minute timer and community voting.
description: Announces one drawing topic daily at a configurable time, defaulting to 20:00 America/New_York. Artists have fifteen minutes to upload one photo of a physical drawing on paper. At least three different artists are required for a five-minute button vote. Everyone has one changeable vote, self-votes are rejected, and the most-voted drawing receives props and cheers. Ties share the applause. Includes 120 rotating topics and recovery of active drawing/voting windows. Staff enforce the physical-only rule; the bot cannot establish how an image was created.
author: Will
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server channel and schedule settings, daily topic rotation, and the current drawing round for restart recovery. Active rounds contain entrant/voter Discord IDs, submission and ballot message IDs, attachment IDs/URLs and vote choices. These records clear when a round ends or is cancelled. No image files, leaderboard or win history are stored locally. User-data deletion cancels affected rounds and clears their stored state. Already posted Discord photos, gallery posts and announcements remain.
install_msg: Daily Drawings installed! Run [p]load dailydrawings, then [p]draw channel #daily-drawings. Default: 8 PM Eastern, 15 minutes to draw, 5 minutes to vote. Change the daily time with [p]draw time 21:00 America/New_York. See [p]draw status and [p]help draw.
